existing_adapter.status: public archived 2026-09-20; one initial commit; no release; README says not published to npm
existing_adapter.implementation: TypeScript fetch adapter for dalgo-js; configured table/field identifiers, parameterized values, point reads, getMany and bounded structured queries; rejects writes/transactions; mocked REST tests only
existing_adapter.critical_gap: One projectId is used both for REST job project and SQL source table project, so it cannot correctly query bigquery-public-data with a distinct user-owned execution project without a split
other_gaps: README explicitly says browser CORS/IAM unverified; no live BigQuery proof
No jobs.cancel on local abort/timeout; submitted jobs can continue and incur charge
No pre-query dry run or cost-preview UX; maximumBytesBilled is optional in constructor
Package peers on old @dal-go/dalgo ^0.1.0; current dalgo-js remote main uses @dalgo/core 0.3.0; compatibility port needed
Explicit key mapping requires unique non-null key and selected flat columns; public tables may lack a guaranteed unique key; complex ARRAY/STRUCT/GEOGRAPHY are not covered by current projection

platform_evidence.public_data: Google hosts storage; query job is charged to execution project. A Google Cloud project is required; sandbox can query public datasets without billing enabled within 1 TiB/month processed. Sandbox own storage is lifetime 10 GiB, objects expire at 60 days, and DML/streaming/transfer are unavailable.
platform_evidence.browser_auth: Google Identity Services token model supports short-lived user-gesture access tokens and REST/CORS calls in principle; exact BigQuery endpoint in target origin remains untested. Web OAuth client ID is public; client secret is server-only. Firebase Google sign-in can request extra scope and expose provider token at result time, but existing Sneat/DataTug sign-in currently requests no BigQuery scope; Firebase ID token is a separate credential.
platform_evidence.iam: jobs.query supports bigquery.readonly OAuth scope but also requires bigquery.jobs.create IAM on execution project and data access to source tables. jobs.cancel needs broader bigquery/cloud-platform OAuth scope and creator's jobs.create or job update; cancellation can still incur cost.
platform_evidence.cost: LIMIT caps returned rows, not bytes scanned. Dry-run can estimate scan without charge; maximumBytesBilled rejects jobs exceeding the cap; use both preview and enforced cap. Client-only cap is user-controlled when user pays, not an enforcement boundary for a shared company project.
platform_evidence.location: Dataset region and job region must match. Cross-region joins/storage results are restricted.
platform_evidence.catalogue: cloud.google.com/datasets features both public and commercial datasets, not a universal public/open-data license. Marketplace page update date is not source-data freshness.
